description.value:
The youngest of the D5 triplets — only entering the market this year — the Lancehead is Nokota’s attempt to provide a low-cost railgun. Their success with the Sidewinder led them to attempt a similar strategy, by bolting an electromag system on the Copperhead’s frame, which was never designed to handle magnetic interference.

Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive)

Class: Assault Rifle • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Carbine

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: 30 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Assault Rifle 3), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Carbine Barrel, Tech Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: While this weapon’s Tech Rebuild is charged, this weapon jams when the user rolls a Critical Failure (1) on an Attack Check as if it was Poor Quality. This weapon cannot be Tech Upgraded to remove this feature.

Range: Carbine
Pre-installed: Carbine Barrel, Tech Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Assault Rifle 3), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
